snippet.title: DRAGON BALL Xenoverse 2 - FUTURE SAGA Chapter 3 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
FUTURE SAGA Chapter 3 drops on October 30!
Broly (DB Super) is joining the fight, and Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), who tapped into forbidden power, is playable too.
When two brilliant minds collide, the most dangerous plan strikes Conton City... #DBXV2
